title: VEKA - Wikipedia
content: # VEKA. **VEKA AG** is a German extruder of uPVC profiles for use in windows, doors, roller shutters and sliding doors headquartered in Sendenhorst, Germany. Founded in 1967 as a manufacturer of shutters, it currently operates its own extrusion facilities in twelve countries. VEKA was founded in Sendenhorst, West Germany under the name Vekaplast in 1967 and initially produced only roller shutters. Due to growing demand, the company acquired his 115,000 square meters of land on the industrial site in Sendenhorst and built a new extrusion plant there after surpassing his 15,000 square meters of leased plant. In 1983, VEKA decided to increase its exports to foreign markets due to economic stagnation in West Germany, establishing subsidiaries in Spain, France, and the United States within a year. In 1993, VEKA opened a 120,000 square foot recycling center and established a subsidiary, VEKA West, Inc., in Reno, Nevada to serve the western United States. VEKA Holdings Inc. was also established to manage his VEKA operations in the United States.

title: About VEKA
content: A family business with fantastic employees. From small business to global market leader in 50 years. Since it was established in 1969, VEKA has evolved from a small local company into a global market leader for PVC profile systems for windows and doors. Today, the family business headquartered in the Westphalia region of Germany is active on four continents: all over the world, quality-conscious consumers are choosing architectural elements made from VEKA quality profiles. From the start, VEKA AG focused on products of the highest quality, and it has steadily expanded its competitive position over the years. The company pursues an investment and expansion policy geared towards sustainable growth – because it continues to cultivate the ethos of a family firm, focusing on customers while also taking responsibility for people and the environment. They know our customers’ requirements and have a great deal of experience with our products. ### We are a family business, so sustainability is in our DNA.

title: VEKA North America History
content: About VEKANewsJoin our TeamContact VEKA. # Our History. ## History of VEKA. VEKA, originally Vekaplast in Germany, shifted from roller shutters to window systems under Heinrich Laumann's leadership in 1971. Their groundbreaking manufacturing site in 1977 spurred global expansion. In 1986, VEKA established its US presence with a state-of-the-art facility in Fombell, PA, followed by a tool and die department in 1988. Expansions included VEKA West in Nevada (1995) and VEKA South in Texas (2006). Despite challenges in the US housing market, VEKA surpassed one billion in sales in 2010. Expansion continued with VEKA East in North Carolina in 2018. The company celebrated its 50th global anniversary in 2019 and marked four decades in North America in 2023, reaffirming its industry leadership. Heinrich Laumann took over the company VEKAPLAST in Sendenhorst, which manufactured roller shutters and building profiles with only 8 employees. Heinrich Laumann on the other hand focused on PVC windows as a product of the future.

title: Corporate Responsibility at VEKA 2022
content: Corporate Responsibility at VEKA 2022   VEKA Group milestones Being future-friendly As a family business, we strive for future-friendly business development with a focus on secure jobs in a healthy environment. We want to create a world that is worth living in, and that is viable and fair for future generations. Only by acting in a future-friendly way can we ensure our long-term viability and success. As a family business, we consider it a matter of course to take responsibility for our actions and to keep future generations in mind in all that we do. This is why we have incorporated the topic of sustainability into our strategy. This is the only way we can ensure future-friendly development and create a future worth living. This booklet aims to make our sustainability activities visible by explaining how VEKA is living up to its corporate responsibility. Wherever possible, and with all the means at our disposal, we do what we can to support our colleagues in Ukraine.
